gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-martian-mono: Loud tubes meet typewriter rigor. Tilt Neon pours out round, constant-width strokes, while Martian Mono sets monospace letters in strict, loose-limbed rows, so the two feel like a neon sign beside a terminal.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-matemasie: Tilt Neon's splayed c gives it away at once. Its open, tubelike letters sit against Matemasie, a plain sans whose small entry points into round letters feel tighter and quieter.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its lowercase tall, like rolled cord, and reads as a plain sans without fuss. And Tilt Neon sits against it as thin steel rod bent into letters, so a little more size on the body text lets the cord shapes breathe.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mitr: A stroke that never changes weight gives Tilt Neon a skimming, tube-like ease up top. Mitr follows with a plain sans body where capitals and lowercase sit close in height, so paragraphs read in a tight, friendly line.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display lets its letters drift apart, with a generous x-height that gives each line room. Tilt Neon above it is bluntly constant, with no tapering at any joint or end.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mukta: Tilt Neon draws rounds and stems in a single weight, with a splayed c terminal and short ascenders. But Mukta underneath is tall-bodied sans-serif, and that height is the real gap between them.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mukta-mahee: Tilt Neon keeps every stroke straight-edged and constant. Mukta Mahee brings chunky, tall lowercase in sans form, so extended reading feels sturdy and friendly rather than fussy or thin.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mukta-malar: Heavy tubes, zero variation in stroke weight: that is Tilt Neon. Yet Mukta Malar tucks its ascenders short and compact, so a slightly larger size for the sans-serif body keeps it comfortable.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani carries a high-waisted lowercase, sitting tall and contemporary on the line. Mukta Vaani against Tilt Neon's cut-ribbon strokes of constant width makes a sharp pairing, since one is all tube and the other all height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-narnoor: Narnoor reads compact, with short ascenders above big bowls. Tilt Neon's contrast-free strokes and large x-height stand against that sans, and the difference in build is what makes the pair memorable.
